notes.title: Visit the Iconic Locations of The Expanse
notes.content:
[p][b]Oye, bosmang kapawu![/b][/p][p][/p][p]It’s been over 2 months since The Expanse: Osiris Reborn was announced, and we have been absolutely blown away by all the support and excitement from the community! While some of our team are off in Cologne at [b]Gamescom 2025[/b], we’ve prepared a small token of our appreciation. Have you been wondering how some of the most iconic locations from The Expanse will look in-game? Well, our intrepid [b]captain[/b] and her [b]twin sister, J,[/b] have prepared a short tour:
[/p][previewyoutube="BfMtfl3BkRA;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Of course, when the game is released, you will be able to create your own captain, customize their sex, appearance, and select a background (Earther, Martian, or Belter). Your identical twin will also change based on your own appearance. notes.title: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn Announcement today at Future Games Show
notes.content:
Greetings, Captain!

Today is truly an exciting day for Owlcat Games, because we can finally introduce you to the project that we have been working on for quite some time — The Expanse: Osiris Reborn, a new sci-fi action RPG based on The Expanse TV show.

By the 24th century, humanity has conquered the cosmos. However, life has remained anything but easy. You start your journey as a simple Pinkwater Security mercenary, enjoying some shore leave on Eros station after a successful mission. But your leisure quickly turns into a nightmare, and you are forced to fight for survival while finding a way to escape an asteroid deathtrap. However, those behind the Eros incident do not plan to leave any loose ends, which means you’ve just made some very powerful enemies.

Become the captain of the most advanced ship in the Solar System, gather your crew, and prepare to fight back. Use your tactical skills, effectively employ cover, and experiment with a wide selection of weapons and combat abilities to confront your enemies. Reach out to various political factions and attempt to earn their trust and support for your mission. Make difficult choices and tough calls, but remember — the universe will never tell you if you were right or wrong.

[previewyoutube=pIQifuOTTe8;full][/previewyoutube]

Wishlist The Expanse: Osiris Reborn:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/3727390/The_Expanse_Osiris_Reborn/

See you on the bridge, Captain!
